name: Nitotem
source: He often acts unhinged and isn't afraid to be rough with his friends. Despite this, he treasures each one dearly, believe that they are closer than family. When he is calm, he is witty and charming.
translation: He often acts unhinged and isn't afraid to be rough with his friends. Despite this, he treasures each one dearly, believe that they are closer than family. When he is calm, he is witty and charming.
